---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: gavinspet
---

## Summary

A one-sentence description of the feature.

## Motivation

Why is this feature useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you'd like this to work. Include:
- New endpoints (if any)
- Changes to existing endpoints
- Architecture impact (which layer does this touch?)

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why did you prefer this one?

## Additional Context

Links, references, or examples that support this request.
